newsitem.title: CHINA: Trading in Sing Tao shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading in Sing Tao shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of publisher Sing Tao Holdings Ltd was suspended on Friday afternoon, a spokesman at the Hong Kong stock exchange said.
Sing Tao later made a statement through the stock exchange saying the trading suspension was on the company's request pending an announcement.
Sing Tao shares soared HK$1.075 or 37.07 percent to HK$3.975 at midday on volume of 15.45 million shares worth HK$58.19 million.
Trading in shares Culturecom Holdings Ltd, a 43 percent owned unit of Sing Tao, was also suspended in the afternoon at its own request pending an announcement.
Culturecom shares rose HK$0.055 or 19.3 percent to HK$0.34 at midday on volume of 38.97 million shares.
